sources.note: Yamaha R series 2nd generation spec page (opened), Rio3224-D2 column: Dimensions W 480 mm x H 220 mm x D 368 mm, net weight 13.5 kg. W includes the rack ears.

Front, straight-on, rack ears included (assets-source/yamaha-rio3224-d2/photos/front.jpg, 4000x1842). Scale 8.333 px/mm horizontally (4000 px = 480 mm over the ears), 8.35 px/mm vertically; origin bottom-left of the ears. The front panel is the io face: it carries 32 XLR inputs, 16 XLR outputs, 8 AES/EBU outputs, the display and the power rocker, i.e. 4 of the 6 modelled ports and the power control. in-mic-1/2 = INPUT 1 and 2 (top-left, pitch 23.8 mm); out-line-1/2 = OUTPUT 1 and 2 (first two XLR males of the lower-right block, pitch 24.0 mm). The catalog models 2 of 32 inputs and 2 of 16 outputs; the first two of each are used. power = the rocker at the top right of the front panel (20.6 x 29.3 mm visible housing; its protrusion d = 10 mm is an estimate, not visible in any view).

Rear, straight-on (assets-source/yamaha-rio3224-d2/photos/rear.jpg, 2000x985): Dante PRIMARY / SECONDARY etherCON top left, two IEC C14 inlets A and B bottom left, two fans. The rear is the opposite face. The photo is shot from behind, so its scale is not the front one: calibrated here at 4.11 px/mm so that the chassis width equals the front panel width (426 mm); x is measured from the centre of the 480 mm box, y from the vertical centre of the chassis. Expect +/- 5 mm on both rear ports. dante-primary = PRIMARY; power-in = inlet A (the catalog has one power port, the unit has two, A and B).

Neutrik NC3FD-L-1 product page (opened): "Standardized D sized 24 mm panel cutout". The XLR receptacles in the photos are Neutrik D-series (NEUTRIK legible on the Rio3224-D2 front), so openingMm = 24 for the XLR ports. The NC3MD-L-1 (male) page says the same (https://www.neutrik.com/en/product/nc3md-l-1).

Neutrik NE8FDP datasheet (opened): D-shape etherCON chassis connector, fits the standardised entertainment-industry panels and accepts any standard RJ45 plug. No cutout number is stated, so no openingMm is given for the Dante port or for the rectangular IEC inlet.
